recommendations.title: Fix H1 Tag Issues
recommendations.detail: Only 82% of pages have exactly one H1. Every page needs exactly one H1 — it's the primary on-page signal.

recommendations.title: Add Organization Schema
recommendations.detail: No Organization schema found. This is the baseline schema every business site needs — it tells Google who you are.

recommendations.title: Install Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
recommendations.detail: No GA4 tracking detected. Without it, there is no data on who visits the site, where they come from, or what they do.

recommendations.title: Add Open Graph Tags
recommendations.detail: Only 32% of pages have complete Open Graph tags. These control how the site looks when shared on social media.

recommendations.title: Fix Missing Image Alt Text
recommendations.detail: Only 0% of pages have all images tagged with alt text. This hurts accessibility and image SEO.

recommendations.title: Fix Duplicate Page Titles
recommendations.detail: 12 pages share a title with another page. Unique titles are required for SEO.

recommendations.title: Reference Sitemap in robots.txt
recommendations.detail: Add 'Sitemap: https://domain.com/sitemap.xml' to robots.txt so all crawlers find it.

recommendations.title: Add llms.txt File
recommendations.detail: Create /llms.txt to help AI systems understand your site. This is the emerging standard for AI-readable site context.

recommendations.title: Install Meta Pixel
recommendations.detail: No Facebook/Meta Pixel detected. Required for retargeting ads and tracking conversions from Meta campaigns.

recommendations.title: Fix Mixed Content
recommendations.detail: 50 page(s) load HTTP resources on HTTPS. Browsers will block these.

recommendations.title: Add Security Headers
recommendations.detail: Only 2/5 security headers set. Add Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options at minimum.

recommendations.title: Add Calls to Action
recommendations.detail: Only 54% of pages have a clear CTA. Every page should guide users to a next step.
